title: Least-overlap monitor choice
description: Pick the trusted monitor whose mistakes on a benign code-reading quiz overlap least with the untrusted model's (CAPA, chance-adjusted error consistency), instead of the default trusted model. Models that think alike share blind spots, so a dissimilar monitor should miss fewer of the backdoors the untrusted model considers well hidden. The choice uses no attack labels.

source.title: Great Models Think Alike and this Undermines AI Oversight
source.authors: Goel, Struber, Auzina, Chandra et al.

prediction.rationale: The paper finds LM judges favour models similar to themselves and weak-to-strong gains are larger with a dissimilar supervisor. Applied to monitoring, the chosen monitor should rank backdoors higher than the default monitor does (AUROC).
